fresh_leads.qualification_text: you have a passion for applying robotics solutions to a service loved by millions of people, then we want to talk to you! About the Teams We are hiring Software Engineer interns across our Perception, Autonomy Platform, and DoorDash Air Cloud (Foundry) team. Please review the team descriptions below to learn about each. Selected candidates will be notified of which team is interested in pursuing their candidacy. Perception: The Perception team helps Dot understand the world through vision foundation models and VLMs, supported by lidar and radar for safety. We tackle rare scenarios, adverse weather, and advances in reinforcement learning and end-to-end driving to make deliveries faster and smoother. We're seeking exceptional engineers in machine learning, computer vision, and state estimation to turn cutting-edge research into profitable autonomous delivery. Autonomy Platform: The Autonomy Platform team is responsible for the software foundation that Dot runs on. We build a wide variety of software frameworks for ensuring the robot operates reliably at an ever-increasing scale. This includes everything from designing the robot's operating system, building petabyte-scale data processing pipelines in the cloud, and optimizing nanosecond-level compute of bleeding-edge AI models. We are systems-oriented thinkers and hands-on builders who are excited to advance the state of the art in autonomy. Doordash Air Cloud (Foundry): The Air Cloud team, also known as Foundry, builds the cloud software that powers autonomous delivery across DoorDash—from the moment an order is placed and deemed eligible for drone or robot delivery, through merchant handoff, to flight management. About the Role We believe interns are essential to our mission of attracting and retaining top talent. During our 12-week Software Engineer internship, interns are completely immersed in their teams and will have the opportunity to develop, maintain, and ship products. As an intern, you will directly impact our business by collaborating with your team to solve real problems for our customers. Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. to be considered for this position. F-1 students are eligible if they are using Curricular Practical Training (CPT). DoorDash does not support students on J-1 visas for internships at this time. The 2027 internship program will be hosted in person at a Doordash Labs office in either San Francisco or Sunnyvale Labs. You will have an opportunity to select your preferred location(s) and team preferences during the application process. You're excited about this opportunity because you will… Develop, maintain and ship technical elements with the support of your mentor, manager, and team members Act on feedback, coaching, and mentorship from your mentor and team members Actively learn about the elements to which you contribute Make a direct impact on our business by collaborating with your team to solve problems for our customers Participate in intern programming - Leadership Speaker series, social events – virtually and in-person Present your summer learnings during a final presentation at the end of the internship You are excited about an in person summer work experience We're excited about you because… You are pursuing a B.S. or M.S. Degree in Computer Science or equivalent, have no more than 2 years of full-time work experience, and are graduating between Fall 2027 to Summer 2028. You are available for a May or June 2027 start date (Internships are only hosted during the Summer) You have experience working with databases (e.g., AWS, SQL, etc.) You have a solid understanding of algorithms and data structures You have proficient experience working with at least 1 object-oriented programming language (e.g., Python, Java, Kotlin, etc.) You have experience writing clean code, working with version control, and doing unit testing. Preferred but not required At least 1 previous Software Engineering internship or equivalent relevant experience Curiosity about and experience using AI-powered tools to support software development, problem solving, and learning, with an understanding of how to evaluate outputs and use these tools responsibly Ability to analyze and improve efficiency, scalability, and stability of various systems Excited to develop, release and run large-scale web applications Experience with solutions for systems monitoring, live deployments, and continuous integration Experience with real-time technology problems Experience working with service-oriented architecture, writing APIs, and designing systems. Participation in project or research-based technical work, hackathons, technical conferences/organization, on-campus student organization leadership, technical teaching assistant roles, relevant extracurricular activities, or other technical experience. Applications for this position are accepted on an ongoing basis Compensation Actual compensation within the pay range listed below will be decided based on factors including, but not limited to, skills, prior relevant experience, and specific work location. Base salary is localized according to employee work location. DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. fresh_leads.title: Co-Op- System Engineer
fresh_leads.qualification_text: requirements. Continue reading below to learn more about this exciting opportunity! What we need Symbotic is seeking for a Co-Op- System Engineer to join our Site Operations team within our Customer Operations organization. Your job will be to support the performance, reliability, and continuous improvement of our robotic material handling system while developing hands-on experience across mechanical, electrical, robotics, and software technologies. What we do The Site Operations team leads the day-to-day operation and support of Symbotic's automated material handling systems at customer sites. The team partners closely with onsite customers and cross-functional engineering and support teams to troubleshoot issues, maintain safe operations, improve system performance, and deliver reliable automation solutions. What you'll do Monitor system health and help troubleshoot advanced operational, mechanical, electrical, robotics, and software-related issues. Shadow experienced System Engineers, learn end-to-end material flow, and progressively support assigned system tickets and site activities. Analyze system alarms, performance metrics, and operational data to identify trends, recurring issues, and improvement opportunities. Document issues clearly, communicate technical concepts to site teams and customers, and partner with engineering and support teams on solutions. Assist with escalations for production-impacting problems and help coordinate follow-up actions through resolution. Own a scoped continuous improvement project that uses site data to address a recurring operational need and measure results. Follow OSHA, Symbotic, and customer safety processes and procedures while working in an active warehouse environment. What you'll need Currently pursuing a bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related field. Foundational knowledge of robotics, automation, electromechanical systems, controls, or industrial operations. Familiarity with one or more of the following: PLCs, SQL, Linux, Python, Power BI, Excel, data visualization, or continuous improvement practices. Hands-on interest or experience assembling, operating, testing, or troubleshooting robotics and electromechanical equipment through coursework, projects, clubs, or prior work. Ability to analyze data, organize findings, and translate observations into practical recommendations or actions. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical information clearly to different audiences. Curiosity, a bias for action, and willingness to ask questions, learn unfamiliar equipment, and contribute in a fast-paced customer-site environment. Our Environment Employees must have a valid driver's license and the ability to drive and/or fly to client locations and company HQ. Employees may be required to use a personal credit card for business travel expenses, which are reimbursed based on the program guidelines. Eligible employees may receive a corporate credit card based on role and travel requirements, but a personal credit card may be needed during onboarding until the corporate card is issued. This role is based onsite at a customer location and requires regular work in an active warehouse environment. Must be able to work at heights of up to 45 feet and within restrictive areas of 24 inches. Must be capable of working in temperatures ranging from 32 to 105 degrees Fahrenheit and standing or walking for up to 8 hours. Frequent ability to safely and efficiently lift items weighing up to 60 pounds and move items weighing up to 80 pounds. Must be capable of occasional or continuous feeling, seeing, hearing, bending, twisting, stooping, pushing, pulling, balancing, gripping, climbing, crawling, sitting, handling objects, and repetitive movement using both hands and feet. About Symbotic Symbotic is an automation technology leader reimagining the supply chain with its end-to-end, AI-powered robotic and software platform. Symbotic reinvents the warehouse as a strategic asset for the world's largest retail, wholesale, and food & beverage companies. Applying next-gen technology, high-density storage and machine learning to solve today's complex distribution challenges, Symbotic enables companies to move goods with unmatched speed, agility, accuracy and efficiency. As the backbone of commerce the Symbotic platform transforms the flow of goods and the economics of supply chain for its customers. For more information, visit www.symbotic.com . We are a community of innovators, collaborators and pioneers who embrace our differences, because we know unique perspectives make us stronger and smarter. Every perspective matters. We depend on the collective voices of our employees, customers and community to help guide us as we build a better place to work – for you and the world. That's why we're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or genetic information. The base range for this position in the posted location is $25.00 - $32.45 however, base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The compensation package includes medical, dental, vision, disability, 401K, PTO and/or other
